inspiration: A single-stroke feature icon family on one square grid gives each feature (rewards, leaderboards, energy, inventory, auctions) its own glyph. Useful UI vocabulary for our hub and HUD. Reference: console/ui/dist/static/hiro_base-CVjIFC1v.svg.
Two-tone gradient glyphs: one gradient per icon with a flat secondary shape. Technique to recreate with our own palette. Reference: console/ui/dist/static/hiro_base-CVjIFC1v.svg line 1.
Matchmaker gate: a match is created only when exactly two queued users share a mode property. Small property check before a match exists. Reference: data/modules/match_init.lua lines 48-62.
Match label as a readable skill bucket (sample default skill=100-150). Idea: lobby labels from queue tags. Reference: data/modules/match.lua line 48.
Tournament windows as data fields (duration, reset schedule, max size) instead of code. Idea: season windows as zone or event data. Reference: data/modules/tournament.lua line 54.
Ops dashboard layout (players, modules, storage panels) for our Pit admin view, not for players. Reference: .github/dashboard.png and .github/players.png.
Authoritative match tick is configured per handler (sample uses 1 per second), so a fast fight would need its own rate. Reference: data/modules/match.lua line 47.

briefs.label: Feature glyph family (UI only, no creature in donor)
briefs.why: A small, consistent set of two-tone glyphs makes a dense menu readable at 375 wide; each glyph is one silhouette idea.
briefs.keep: one square grid for all glyphs; one gradient per icon with a flat secondary shape; one readable silhouette per feature
briefs.change: our own palette and stroke weight; our own feature shapes (not the donor's shape set); a tinted rim that matches the Pit grade
